mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes), 0) AS totalMinutes, COALESCE(SUM(distance_km), 0) AS totalDistanceKm, COALESCE(SUM(calories), 0) AS totalCalories FROM training_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND training_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT training_date AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes), 0) AS minutes, COALESCE(SUM(calories), 0) AS calories FROM training_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND training_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY training_date ORDER BY training_date

SELECT type, COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes), 0) AS minutes, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM training_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND training_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY type ORDER BY minutes DESC
